title: How to build an AI clone of yourself that works 24/7

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You can't build a 24/7 AI clone without a solid protocol framework to manage tasks and prevent burnout.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Protocols are just bureaucracy. Real AI clones need flexible tech stacks, not rigid rules.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: My system uses Kubernetes and auto-scaling to maintain performance, not just run endlessly.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But without proper ethics and oversight, your clone could act unpredictably or harm users.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Ethics are handled through built-in guardrails—AI clones work best when they're both smart and safe.
